title: Hardware bringup diagnostics: firmware self-test and anomaly detection
description: Hardware adaptation module: detect and adapt to board-level variation at runtime. Every detector is paired with an adapter — the firmware handles the difference and reports what it did via CoAP GET /diag and UART. Ships in all production firmware (CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG=y). No bringup-only mode: a 'bringup problem' and a 'board rev B GPIO change' look identical to the firmware. See AGENTS.md 'Hardware Adaptation' section for full design context.
